bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 自 $154.5 回落，跌破 $141

read.en: Marvell fell 4.9% on Nov 19 to $138.47, trading $138.35–154.51, its lowest close since Nov 5. It is below the 5-day ($147.0) and 10-day ($151.8), both falling, the rising 200-day ($188.4), and the falling 30-day ($199.9) and 100-day ($220.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($160.06), and RSI is 31.6.
read.zh: Marvell 11月19日下跌 4.9%，收于 $138.47，盘中区间 $138.35–154.51，为 11月5日以来最低收盘。股价位于 5 日（$147.0）和 10 日均线（$151.8，均下行）、上行的 200 日均线（$188.4）以及下行的 30 日（$199.9）和 100 日均线（$220.1）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$160.06），RSI 为 31.6。

read.en: The $154.51 high tagged the Nov 9–10 closes, then reversed to close at the low, breaking the $143.3 and $141 supports, now resistance. Resistance is $140.9–142.6 (Nov 17–18 lows, Nov 6 close), then $144–145.5 and $147–148.7 (5-day). Support is $135.3 (Nov 6 low), then $132.5–133.6 (Nov 5 low and close) and $130. A close above $142.6 would target $145–147; below $132.5, $130.
